card.architecture: Qwen-Image 2.1 unified 7B single-stream DiT (Qwen3-VL 8B encoder, 64-channel RGBA VAE, flow matching)
card.summary: Qwen's compact unified generation/editing model. Strong typography, portraits and realistic texture; native transparent PNG generation and direct output up to 2048px. The INT8 ConvRot build targets 24 GB renderers.
card.commercial_use: no (Qwen Research License; separate commercial license required)
card.pick_when: You want the newest Qwen image quality, good text rendering, or a real alpha channel, and non-commercial use is acceptable.

prompt.guidance: Use detailed natural-language prose. Quote exact visible text. For alpha output, explicitly request an RGBA image with transparency and a transparent background.
prompt.example: This is an RGBA format image with transparency. A polished chrome robot holding a small sign reading "HELLO", studio product lighting. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
prompt.instructions: Describe the subject, composition, lighting, materials, and any exact quoted text. Default sampling is CFG 1, Euler/simple, 25 steps; 40-50 steps can improve quality. Output supports 1024px by default and up to native 2048px; use multiples of 32. Save as PNG to retain transparency.
do: Explicitly request RGBA transparency when needed
dont: Expect a negative prompt to act at CFG 1
Use a lossy output format for transparency
prompt.negative_guidance: Unused at the official CFG 1 default. Raise CFG only if deliberately using a negative prompt.

negative.note: The official path uses CFG 1, so the negative branch has no effect by default.

speed.note: 7B visual model; official template starts at 25 steps.

ui_help.note: Describe the image in plain language. Mention RGBA and a transparent background when you need a cutout with real alpha.
ui_help.good_for: newest Qwen quality, text, portraits, products, and transparency
